title: Compose the separately evaluated clopen arrow factors
statement: For an arbitrary inverse ring sequence R_n and a proper/open square kp=ri with quasi-compact open k,i and proper r,p, there is a single-coefficient natural transformation a:D(i_!)D(p^*) -> D(r^*)D(k_!) such that the alpha arrow of [def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows] evaluates to a with the specified evalG and evalJ comparisons, and StrictTower.alpha for R_n evaluates at zero to the same a. Both equalities hold for every derived input. This is the conjunction of the two explicit component equations in clopenArrowEvaluation; all coefficient functors are the actual exact-localized module pullbacks and open extensions.

proof.text: Set a=b followed by c. The alpha_factorization and strictAlpha_factorization equations of [def-sp-varying-ring-clopen-arrow-factors] identify alpha with the two factors. Evaluation preserves their composite. Substitute first the section comparison, then the cartesian beta comparison; associativity gives both asserted equations exactly. This is a finite composition of equal morphisms, with no evaluation-faithfulness argument.

lean.statement:
theorem clopenArrowEvaluation {V W S T : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S)
    (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
    [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p]
    (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : (StrictTower.moduleJ (R n) i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
          (StrictTower.modulePullback (R n) p).mapDerivedCategory ⟶
        (StrictTower.modulePullback (R n) r).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
          (StrictTower.moduleJ (R n) k).mapDerivedCategory,
      (∀ N : Derived R φ S,
        (ev R φ W n).map ((alpha R φ k r p i h).app N) ≫
            (evalJ R φ k n).hom.app ((G R φ r).obj N) ≫
            (StrictTower.moduleJ (R n) k).mapDerivedCategory.map
              ((evalG R φ r n).hom.app N) =
          (evalG R φ p n).hom.app ((J R φ i).obj N) ≫
            (StrictTower.modulePullback (R n) p).mapDerivedCategory.map
              ((evalJ R φ i n).hom.app N) ≫ a.app ((ev R φ S n).obj N)) ∧
      (∀ N : StrictTower.Derived (R n) S,
        (StrictTower.ev (R n) W 0).map ((StrictTower.alpha (R n) k r p i h).app N) ≫
            (StrictTower.evalJ (R n) k 0).hom.app ((StrictTower.G (R n) r).obj N) ≫
            (StrictTower.moduleJ (R n) k).mapDerivedCategory.map
              ((StrictTower.evalG (R n) r 0).hom.app N) =
          (StrictTower.evalG (R n) p 0).hom.app ((StrictTower.J (R n) i).obj N) ≫
            (StrictTower.modulePullback (R n) p).mapDerivedCategory.map
              ((StrictTower.evalJ (R n) i 0).hom.app N) ≫
            a.app ((StrictTower.ev (R n) S 0).obj N))
